name: loom
description: Local folder-of-files knowledge base (SQLite + BM25 + LLM). Search and ask over your own notes — no embeddings, no cloud.

config_path.title: Loom config file
config_path.description: Path to your Loom config.toml (created by `loom init`). Defaults to ~/.loom/config.toml.

tools.name: loom_search
tools.description: BM25 search over the local index — raw hits, no LLM call

tools.name: loom_ask
tools.description: Ask a question; retrieves then answers with the configured LLM, with citations

tools.name: loom_get_file
tools.description: Return the indexed content of a file by rel_path, whole or as a byte range

tools.name: loom_grep
tools.description: Regex search over indexed content — matching lines with offsets, no LLM call

tools.name: loom_list_files
tools.description: List every indexed file with summary and keywords
